messages.text: Thursday, October 15 · Canton, Michigan
Light rain meets robot trust and monster lore
A damp autumn day offers a local exhibition on East Asian monsters and research into trusting security robots. Consider an evening of improv comedy for a diversion.
Expect light rain today with a high near 65°F and a low around 53°F, carrying a 69% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:47 AM and sunset at 6:52 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing crescent, 19.9% illuminated.
Local diversions for a rainy day

The Hatcher Graduate Library in Ann Arbor hosts "From Frightful to Delightful: East Asian Monsters in the Stacks" starting at 4 PM. For evening entertainment, consider "An Evening in the Comedy Cauldron" at Go Comedy Improv Theater in Ferndale at 7:30 PM or "The Thursday Show" at Black Box in Hamtramck at 8 PM.
The first quarter moon arrives on October 18th.
Google data center decision looms for Van Buren Township

Van Buren Township is nearing a decision on a proposed Google data center, with officials working to finalize agreements on mitigating environmental impacts and potential utility cost increases for residents. Google is expected to cover any residential utility increases.
Looking toward the weekend and beyond
The Orionids meteor shower is expected to peak around October 21st, offering a chance for celestial viewing.

Friday, October 16 · Canton, Michigan
Drizzle and data: trust in robots, breaking clots

A damp autumn day brings a high near 63°F and a low around 44°F with a 69% chance of precipitation. Local news focuses on a potential data center decision, while science explores public trust in robots and innovative medical devices.
Expect light drizzle today with a high near 63°F and a low around 44°F, and a 69% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:48 AM, sunset at 6:50 PM, with the moon waxing crescent and 28.0% illuminated.
Dramatics and discussions

For an evening of interactive theater, consider "Big Fun Murder | An Improvised Murder Mystery" at Go Comedy Improv Theater in Ferndale at 9:30 PM. Alternatively, "THEATRE l I'd Love to Have You for Dinner" in Hamtramck offers a psychological thriller at 8:00 PM.
The first quarter moon is on October 18.
Van Buren Township data center decision looms

Van Buren Township is nearing a decision on a large Google data center, with officials working to finalize agreements that would mitigate potential environmental impacts and utility cost increases for residents. The township supervisor indicated Google would cover residential utility costs.
Looking ahead: meteor showers and eclipses
The Orionids meteor shower is expected to peak around October 21. Mark your calendars for the full moon on October 26.
